snippet.title: Bylina - Galaxies Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Step into a myth-soaked adventure in Bylina. As Falconet, a young bogatyr born without powers, you are revived by a mysterious spirit and thrust into the Far Far Kingdom. Battle legendary beasts, master weapons and spells, and uncover a hidden myth rooted in Slavic folklore. Through ruins, forests and dungeons you will grow stronger, shape your destiny, and confront an ancient evil that threatens your very soul.
